create_fake_dataset: create a fake ASE database from a FakeDatasetConfig with random atomic structures and LJ energies
generate_structures: generate fake atomic structures with Lennard-Jones energies and repulsive pairwise forces from a config
create_fake_benchmark_dataset: create all five UMA benchmark datasets with train and val splits in a temp directory
FakeDatasetConfig_get_split_config: get the split configuration dictionary with src and optional metadata path from a FakeDatasetConfig
FakeDatasetConfig_get_normalization_cons: get the energy and forces normalization constants including mean and stdev from a FakeDatasetConfig
